name: Sakamoto Ryouma
source:
A samurai from the Tosa region.
When he was young he was a crybaby and coward, but he grew into a man who could be considered the best swordsman in Tosa.
When he went to Edo for swordsmanship training he saw the western ships and became more aware of the world.
